messages:
Priya Nair: quick sync — product asked for a way to route low-tier customers to cheaper model builds (int8 / 4k context) by region, but keep enterprise on high-qp models. want the console + API to make this explicit.
Alex Gomez: +1. do we treat this as a routing policy or a per-tenant profile? seems like policy lets us do region overrides.
Samir Patel: leaning towards 'tenant routing profile' + global fallbacks. profile contains preferences: preferred_variant, max_token_cost_per_request, allowed_quantizations, region_penalty_whitelist.
Priya Nair: example API shape i sketched:
```
POST /v1/routing-profiles
{"tenant_id": "acct_123", "profile": {"preferred_variant": "rwd-7b-q4_0", "max_token_cost_usd": "0.0004", "regions": {"eu": {"min_variant": "rwd-7b-q4_0"}, "us": {}}}}
```
Jo Chen: console UX: dropdown for 'economy profile' vs 'standard' with a slider for max token cost. also show estimated per-request cost under the chosen prompt size.
Alex Gomez: telemetry: we need to record which route was chosen and why (policy, capacity, region penalty, customer budget). Add fields to request_log: chosen_variant, reason_code, cost_estimate_usd.
Samir Patel: +1 to reason_code. suggested codes: PREFER, CAPACITY_FALLBACK, COST_LIMIT, REGION_RESTRICTION, SLO_OVERRIDE.
Priya Nair: important: prefer deterministic API behavior. if max_token_cost blocks primary variant, return chosen_variant in response headers and include fallback note. do not silently change for the caller without trace.
ConsoleBot: FYI: rollout flag `routing_profiles_v1` enabled for 20% of orgs in prod.
Jo Chen: rollout plan — enable console controls for internal SE org first, log all changes and surface a 'simulated cost impact' preview before committing.
Alex Gomez: edge case — streaming responses: cheaper variant might cut tokens differently. ensure our cost estimator uses expected tokens for streaming vs final completion.
Samir Patel: can we expose a preview API: `POST /v1/routing-simulate` with prompt + tenant -> returns ordered candidate variants and estimated cost & latency? would help SEs and console preview.
Priya Nair: love that. add an audit event every time a routing_profile is applied to a request. that feeds quality monitoring and regression alerts (prompt sets failing after variant switch).
Jo Chen: UX nits: show green/yellow/red badges for 'meets SLA' vs 'cost-saving' vs 'risk of regression'. hide advanced fields under 'expert mode'.
Alex Gomez: next steps: Samir to prototype simulation API + telemetry fields. Jo to wire console mockups with simulated preview. Priya will draft an internal policy doc mapping reason_codes to effects. I'll add the rollout flag in infra and enable logging.
Samir Patel: i'll post a short PR with proto for `routing_simulate` and a minimal request_log schema change.
Priya Nair: thanks team. ping me when mocks are ready, aim for canary in 2 weeks. :thumbsup:
